text:
marta: Heads up: eu-west GPU tail latency +10% between 03:10-03:25 UTC. Traces point to PCIe saturation on node gpunode-42. Noticed same tenant id 'nlp-batch-13' doing sustained >4k reqs/s batch jobs. Anyone else see?

devon: yep saw that. I pulled pcie counters. looks like DMA bursts from that tenant. Could be multi-tenant noisy neighbor. Recommending temporary isolate to a dedicated pool for that tenant.

scheduler-bot: alert: high_pcie_utilization gpunode-42 (svc: nlp-batch-13) — auto-shepherd not triggered (policy: soft-isolation).

kai: Can we avoid full carve-out? Dedicated pool will cost extra. Maybe placement hinting + rate-limiting at proxy first.

ash: we have placement-hint labels but kube scheduler ignores them sometimes due to packing heuristics. We could add a per-tenant 'noise-sentinel' that watches pcie and triggers 'hint:avoid' label.

marta: devon, can you sketch sentinel behavior? I'm thinking rapid detection window (30s) then ephemeral carve to warm pool.

devon: sketch below. sentinel runs as daemonset, samples nvml+eBPF, posts to infra-api. infra-api then writes placement annotation to tenant resource. Example payload: ```curl -X POST https://infra-api/_internal/noise -d '{"tenant":"nlp-batch-13","score":0.87,"metric":"pcie_tx"}'```

oliver: if we tag with hint:avoid, scheduler should respect it with new predicate. But what about existing pods on same node? Eviction cost is high.

kai: we could instead throttle at proxy for that tenant for short window (backpressure) while we drain new allocations from that AZ. Less churn.

ash: throttling helps but doesn't protect customers sharing GPU memory/KV cache. Eviction+dedicated is the only robust isolation.

marta: tradeoffs: customer impact vs cost. For enterprise customers we can offer 'noisy tenant protection' premium that auto-allocates to dedicated slices.

devon: proposed rollout: 1) pilot sentinel in eu-west (non-prod), 2) add scheduler predicate honoring 'avoid' hints, 3) implement proxy throttle fallback, 4) opt-in dedicated carveout + billing tag.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout started: noise-sentinel v0.1 to eu-west non-prod

kai: metrics to monitor: pcie_tx tail percentiles, KV cache miss rate, per-tenant qps, allocation churn. Also cost delta per carveout.

oliver: who owns infra-api change? I can take the scheduler predicate. marta can you own sentinel ops?

marta: yep I'll own ops for pilot. devon will pair on infra-api contract.

devon: I'll open PR with API schema and sample payloads. quick note: telemetry rate should be low (<1/s per node) to avoid extra load.

ash: we need a k8s admission step to tag pods started by older controllers — else early placements bypass hints.

marta: good call. Add admission hook in plan.

devon: PR link when ready: https://git.internal/redwood/infra-api/pulls/782 (WIP)

oliver: :thumbsup: schedule a 30min sync tomorrow 09:00 UTC to align on rollout and cost modeling?

kai: count me in. I'll prepare cost model for dedicated slices (approx $X/hr per slice) and break-even.

marta: thanks all. I'll post runbook and dashboards after pilot. closing for now unless someone has objections.

scheduler-bot: note: alert resolved on gpunode-42 — tail latency returned to baseline after temporary soft-evict at 03:33 UTC.

devon: follow-up: I'll add histogram to infra-metrics for per-tenant pcie bursts.
